I've become more supportive of the corporate tax over the years


Morten N. Støstad (@MortenStostad)

More and more evidence indicates that the corporate income tax is the most important progressive tax we have.

A forthcoming AER paper shows that the Trump corporate income tax cuts largely benefited the top 10%. This is reminiscent of previous non-incidence analysis, linked.

This paper was obviously crap (it's Borjas, so of course it's crap), but I didn't expect the whole result to be driven by ONE CODING ERROR


Saloni (@salonium)

A few months ago, a high profile paper in Science claimed to find that researchers' ideology produced biased results in favour of immigration.

A reanalysis of the data finds that result came from a coding error, which once corrected, shows no effect.

Will people who shared that original finding update their views?
